title: 第102章 虫云破罡降维打击第101章 贪婪的探路者
slug: 游戏入侵开局挖掌天瓶
content_zh:
地下溶洞，空气冷得刺骨。
五名顶尖玩家，踩碎了灰白色的干枯药土。靴底碾过那些被苏寒刨开的坑洼，发出沉闷的脚步声。
二十五级的狂暴灵力，在他们身上毫无保留地释放。
队伍最前方的武僧，双臂猛然合十。浑身肌肉块块暴突，皮肤表面浮现出一层犹如实质的暗金色佛光。系统技能【罗汉金钟罩】开启。
高达三尺厚的半透明金钟虚影，将他整个人倒扣在内。金钟表面流转着梵文，这是现阶段《荒域》中能硬抗同阶首领boss全力一击的顶级防御。
两名剑客一左一右，长剑上吞吐着炽烈的红色剑芒。高温将周围的陈年霉气炙烤得扭曲变形。
女阵法师捏碎了一张高阶【疾风符】。青色的风系能量包裹住五人的双腿。
五人的移动速度骤然飙升三倍。化作五道狂暴的残影，呈现出完美的半包围绞杀阵型，直扑三十丈外的苏寒。
“爆了他！”
王腾拖着那把散发紫光的极品长剑，眼底的贪婪化作实质的杀意。
三十丈。二十丈。十丈。
距离急速拉近。
苏寒站在碳化枯树的阴影里。一动不动。
他没有去拔腰间的精钢砍刀。也没有后退半步。
漆黑的眼眸，冷酷地注视着这五头撞向枪口的猎物。
在他的视网膜上，这五个人不是高高在上的宗门天骄。而是五具主动送上门的骨架。
十步。
进入绝杀射程。
苏寒抬起左臂。
宽大的黑色袖管，平直地对准了迎面扑来的五名高阶玩家。

“去。”
识海深处，一道没有任何温度的指令下达。
“嗡——！”
一声极其诡异、尖锐的锐鸣，在空旷的溶洞内轰然炸响！
这不是风声。这是上百只微小膜翅以超越人类听觉极限的高频振动，同时切割空气引发的恐怖音爆。
一团暗金色的云雾，从苏寒的袖口中狂涌而出！
速度快到了极致。在视网膜上拖拽出一条笔直的暗金色死亡轨迹。
冲在最前方的武僧，眼角余光只瞥见一团黑乎乎的东西迎面砸来。
“暗器？还是毒粉？”
武僧冷嗤出声。他不闪不避，反而挺起胸膛，将【罗汉金钟罩】的真气催动到极限。
“老子的金钟罩免疫一切低阶毒素和暗器！给我破！”
他挥舞降魔杵，迎着那团暗金色的云雾狠狠砸下。
降魔杵砸空了。
云雾在接触到降魔杵的瞬间，极其诡异地一分为二，犹如拥有独立意识的流体，直接绕过了重型兵器。
随后，狠狠地撞击在武僧体表那层厚达三尺的暗金色金钟虚影上。
“啪嗒。啪嗒。啪嗒。”
content_en:
The air in the underground cave is bone-chillingly cold.
Five top players crushed the gray-white dried medicinal soil. The soles of the boots ran over the potholes dug by Su Han, making a dull sound of footsteps.
Level 25 violent spiritual power was unleashed on them without reservation.
The monk at the front of the team suddenly clasped his arms together. Muscles all over his body protruded, and a layer of dark golden Buddha light appeared on the surface of his skin. The system skill [Arhat Golden Bell] is activated.
The three-foot-thick translucent golden bell phantom held his whole body upside down. Sanskrit is flowing on the surface of the golden clock. This is the top defense in "Desolate Realm" at this stage that can resist the full blow of the boss of the same level.
Two swordsmen stood on the left and right, their long swords glowing with blazing red light. The high temperature distorted the surrounding old mold.
The female array mage crushed a high-level [Wind Talisman]. The cyan wind energy enveloped the legs of the five people.
The movement speed of the five people suddenly tripled. It turned into five violent afterimages, showing a perfect semi-encirclement and strangulation formation, and rushed towards Su Han, who was thirty feet away.
"Blast him!"
Wang Teng dragged the top-quality long sword that emitted purple light, and the greed in his eyes turned into actual murderous intent.
Thirty feet. Twenty feet. Ten feet.
The distance quickly closed.
Su Han stood in the shadow of the carbonized dead tree. Not moving.
He did not pull out the stainless steel machete from his waist. He didn't even take a step back.
His dark eyes stared coldly at the five prey that were rushing towards the muzzle of the gun.
In his eyes, these five people were not the arrogant geniuses of the sect. Instead, there were five skeletons delivered to the door.
Ten steps.
Entering the killing range.
Su Han raised his left arm.
The wide black sleeves were pointed straight at the five high-level players rushing towards them.
"Go."
Deep in the sea of ​​consciousness, an order without any temperature was issued.
“Buzz——!”
An extremely weird and sharp scream exploded in the empty cave!
This is not a rumor. This is a terrifying sonic boom caused by hundreds of tiny membrane wings vibrating at high frequencies that exceed the limit of human hearing and cutting the air at the same time.
A dark golden cloud surged out from Su Han's sleeves!
The speed was extremely fast. Drag a straight dark golden death trail on the retina.
The monk who was rushing at the front only caught a glimpse of a black thing coming towards him from the corner of his eye.
"Hidden weapon? Or poison powder?"
The monk sneered coldly. He did not dodge, but instead puffed out his chest and pushed the infuriating energy of [Arhat's Golden Bell] to the limit.
"My golden bell is immune to all low-level poisons and hidden weapons! Break it for me!"
He waved the Demon-Conquering Pestle and struck it hard against the dark golden cloud.
The magic pestle was smashed empty.
The moment the cloud and mist came into contact with the Demon Subduing Pestle, it split into two extremely strangely, like a fluid with independent consciousness, directly bypassing the heavy weapon.
Then, it hit hard on the three-foot-thick dark golden golden bell phantom on the monk's body.
"Crack. Crack. Crack."
